result.summary: This Outsourcing Agreement governs the licensing and support of E.piphany software applications by High Speed Net Solutions, Inc. The contract contains significant financial and liability exposure for the customer, including broad unilateral indemnities and a liability cap tied to initial term payments. Several modern SaaS and AI policy playbook rules are entirely unaddressed due to the legacy nature of the document.

categoryScores.comment: R-AI-01 Not Addressed: The agreement is completely silent on AI training rights, data boundaries, and generalized foundation models.
R-AI-02 Not Addressed: There are no uptime guarantees or financial service credits specified in the contract excerpts.
R-AI-03 Fail: The liability cap is strictly one-sided and tied to initial term payments without appropriate super-caps for IP or data breaches.
R-AI-04 Not Addressed: The agreement contains no provisions regarding subprocessor transparency or security incident notification timeframes.
R-AI-05 Pass: Payment terms comply with the standard Net 30 requirement.

keyFacts.label: Liability Cap
keyFacts.value: Sum total of payments made under initial term

agentPerspectives.roleDescription: Represents the vendor's interests to maximize protection and limit liability.
agentPerspectives.stance: Defensive on liability caps and indemnities while securing upfront non-refundable payments.
keyPoints: Limited vendor liability strictly to fees paid under the initial term.
Imposed broad indemnification obligations on the customer.
agentPerspectives.counterOfferRecommendation: Maintain current payment terms but offer mutual liability adjustments if pressed.

agentPerspectives.roleDescription: Focuses on closing the transaction while managing core commercial risks.
agentPerspectives.stance: Pragmatic approach to balance financial commitments with operational requirements.
keyPoints: Development license fees and maintenance milestones are clearly structured.
Support obligations are clearly delineated between primary and secondary support.
agentPerspectives.counterOfferRecommendation: Approve the commercial fee structure while requesting standard SLA commitments.

agentPerspectives.roleDescription: Evaluates agreement against enterprise SaaS policies and security baselines.
agentPerspectives.stance: Critical review of missing security, SLA, and data privacy provisions.
keyPoints: R-AI-01 fails due to complete absence of model data boundaries.
R-AI-02 fails due to lack of uptime SLAs and service credits.
R-AI-03 fails because liability is capped rigidly without super-caps.
agentPerspectives.counterOfferRecommendation: Insert robust data privacy, SLA, and subprocessor compliance clauses before signing.

redlines.originalText: IN NO EVENT SHALL E.PIPHANY'S LIABILITY HEREUNDER EXCEED THE SUM TOTAL OF PAYMENTS MADE BY HSNS UNDER THE INITIAL TERM OF THIS AGREEMENT.
redlines.proposedText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY HEREUNDER EXCEED THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY HSNS UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS PRECEDING THE CLAIM, EXCEPT THAT SUCH CAP SHALL BE THREE TIMES (3x) SUCH FEES FOR BREACHES OF CONFIDENTIALITY, IP INDEMNIFICATION, OR DATA BREACH OBLIGATIONS.

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: E.piphany will argue that tying the liability cap to total initial payments provides a balanced and predictable risk allocation given their pricing structure.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: A pure initial term cap limits recovery severely in multi-year or enterprise deployments, exposing HSNS to unmitigated downside risk.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Aligns the liability structure with standard enterprise SaaS norms by utilizing a trailing 12-month fee metric and an appropriate super-cap for IP and data security breaches.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We can agree to a standard annual fee cap if you accept a 3x super-cap for intellectual property and confidentiality breaches.

redlines.originalText: HSNS hereby agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless E.piphany, and its officers, directors and partners ... against any and all claims ... arising out of or resulting from (i) HSNS's providing or failure to provide Outsourcing Services
redlines.proposedText: Each party shall mutually indemnify, defend, and hold harmless the other party against third-party claims arising from gross negligence, willful misconduct, or material breach of confidentiality.

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: E.piphany will argue that as the technology provider, they already offer a standard IP indemnification in Section 10.1 while HSNS must bear the operational risks of servicing Outsourcing Customers.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: One-sided indemnification exposes HSNS to open-ended liability for third-party outsourcing claims without reciprocal protections.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Indemnification obligations must be mutual and proportionate to each party's operational control and breach risks.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We require reciprocal indemnification for third-party claims resulting from each party's respective breaches and negligence.

redlines.originalText: HSNS hereby assigns all right, title and interest in and to any customization, enhancement, amendment or changes made by or for HSNS pursuant to this Agreement
redlines.proposedText: HSNS shall retain all right, title, and interest in and to any custom developments, configurations, or enhancements specifically created for HSNS, and grants E.piphany a license solely to provide the services.

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: E.piphany will assert that ownership uniformity of the core application and its modifications is essential to prevent fragmentation and protect their proprietary intellectual property.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: Assigning custom developments paid for by HSNS deprives HSNS of proprietary ownership in valuable modifications.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Custom deliverables financed entirely by the customer should remain customer property or be licensed back appropriately.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: HSNS must own the specific customizations it funds, while E.piphany retains all underlying core IP.

redlines.originalText: All Professional Services not otherwise specified in the Order Form shall be provided on a time and materials basis.
redlines.proposedText: All Professional Services not otherwise specified in the Order Form shall be provided on a time and materials basis subject to a mutual written estimate and not-to-exceed cap.

chainOfThought.opposingCounselStance: E.piphany will maintain that time and materials billing is standard and necessary because the exact scope of professional services cannot always be predetermined.
chainOfThought.commercialRiskAssessment: Uncapped time and materials billing creates financial exposure and budget unpredictability for professional services.
chainOfThought.legalRationale: Introducing a cap or requirement for written estimates protects the customer from runaway professional service costs.
chainOfThought.negotiationTalkingPoint: We are open to T&M billing provided we agree on written estimates and a not-to-exceed ceiling for each statement of work.

obligations.requirement: HSNS shall meet with E.piphany on a quarterly basis to discuss non-binding forecasts and provide a non-binding, rolling six-month forecast report in advance.
obligations.triggerOrDeadline: Quarterly in advance of the meeting
obligations.breachConsequence: Material breach if not cured within thirty days of written notice.

obligations.requirement: HSNS shall pay E.piphany the fees specified in Exhibit A and generated by HSNS's use of the Application.
obligations.triggerOrDeadline: As specified in an applicable Annual Report
obligations.breachConsequence: Late payment charge and possible termination for material breach.

obligations.requirement: All amounts due and owing shall be paid within thirty days from the invoice date.
obligations.triggerOrDeadline: Within thirty days from the date of E.piphany's invoice
obligations.breachConsequence: Overdue payments shall accrue a late payment charge at the lesser of one and one half percent per month or maximum allowed by law.

obligations.requirement: HSNS shall discontinue use of the Application and certify in writing that all copies have been returned or destroyed.
obligations.triggerOrDeadline: Within ten days of termination of this Agreement

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: HSNS hereby agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless E.piphany, and its officers, directors and partners against any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, costs, expenses, penalties, losses and liabilities arising from proceedings against the Indemnified Party.
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: (a) Provider Indemnification. Provider shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer... (b) Customer Indemnification. Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Provider... (c) Procedure.
deviations: Indemnification is heavily one-sided in favor of E.piphany, lacking mutual provider IP indemnification.
missingProtections: Provider IP infringement indemnification for the customer.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Add mutual intellectual property indemnification protections to balance risk between provider and customer.

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: 3.1, 3.4, 4.3, 6.2, 6.4, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13 and 14 shall survive any termination or expiration of this Agreement.
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: Provisions which by their nature should survive termination, including confidentiality, indemnification, limitation of liability, payment of accrued fees, data return and deletion, and governing law, survive the expiry or termination of this Agreement.
deviations: Survival relies on an enumerated list of section numbers rather than a standard categorical definition.
missingProtections: Explicit general survival statement for all provisions that by their nature should survive.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Ensure the referenced section numbers accurately capture all critical clauses like confidentiality and indemnification.

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: THIS ALLOCATION TO WHICH THE PARTIES HAVE AGREED. THIS LIMITATION OF LIABILITY APPLIES NOTWITHSTANDING ANY FAILURE OF THE ESSENTIAL PURPOSE OF THE EXCLUSIVE REMEDIES.
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardTitle: 12-Month Trailing Aggregate Fee Cap with Balanced Super-Cap
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: (a) Consequential Damages Waiver... (b) General Aggregate Cap... (c) Super-Cap for Data Protection Breaches...
deviations: The excerpts do not show a standard trailing 12-month aggregate fee cap or explicit super-cap.
missingProtections: Express aggregate liability cap based on trailing fees.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Incorporate a clear aggregate liability cap and consequential damages waiver.

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: HSNS acknowledges that E.piphany retains all right, title and interest in the Application and any modifications thereto...
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardTitle: Customer Work Product Ownership & Non-Use of Customer Data for AI Training
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: (a) Work Product... (b) Customer Data & AI Model Boundaries... (c) Feedback License...
deviations: Modifications and customizations are assigned to E.piphany rather than customer ownership of deliverables.
No explicit restriction on using customer data for AI training.
missingProtections: Prohibition against using customer data for training AI models.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Add explicit protections ensuring customer ownership of custom deliverables and restricting AI data usage.

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: For any breach of the warranties contained in Section 4.1, HSNS's sole and exclusive remedy, and E.piphany's entire liability, shall be: (i) in the case of a nonconforming Application, to correct the nonconforming Application...
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: The Provider warrants that (a) the Services will perform materially in accordance with the Documentation... If a warranty is breached... Provider shall re-perform...
deviations: Remedies focus heavily on correction or license termination rather than standardized re-performance with specific cure windows.
missingProtections: Standardized 90-day reporting window and defined re-performance cure periods.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Align warranty remedies to include explicit re-performance and defined refund mechanics.

benchmarkComparisons.contractClauseText: HSNS acknowledges that E.piphany retains all right, title and interest in the Application and any modifications thereto...
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardTitle: Each Party Keeps Its Pre-Existing IP; Licence to Deliverables
benchmarkComparisons.goldStandardText: Each party retains all rights in its intellectual property existing before or developed independently of this Agreement. The Customer owns all deliverables created specifically for it upon payment...
deviations: Contract assigns custom modifications to E.piphany rather than Customer owning deliverables created for them.
benchmarkComparisons.recommendation: Revise IP terms to ensure pre-existing IP remains with each party and customer owns custom work product.

rules.explanation: The agreement is completely silent on AI training rights, data boundaries, and generalized foundation models.
rules.recommendation: Add a clause explicitly prohibiting the use of customer data for training generalized foundation models.

rules.explanation: There are no uptime guarantees or financial service credits specified in the contract excerpts.
rules.recommendation: Incorporate a high availability SLA guaranteeing 99.5% uptime backed by escalating monthly service credits.

rules.evidence: IN NO EVENT SHALL E.PIPHANY'S LIABILITY HEREUNDER EXCEED THE SUM TOTAL OF PAYMENTS MADE BY HSNS UNDER THE INITIAL TERM OF THIS AGREEMENT.
rules.explanation: The liability cap is strictly one-sided and tied to initial term payments without appropriate super-caps for IP or data breaches.
rules.recommendation: Negotiate a mutual enterprise super-cap for data breaches and IP infringement claims to align with playbook standards.

rules.explanation: The agreement contains no provisions regarding subprocessor transparency or security incident notification timeframes.
rules.recommendation: Require a public subprocessor list with 30-day advance notice of changes and mandatory security incident notification within 24 hours.

rules.evidence: all amounts due and owing by HSNS shall be paid within thirty (30) days from the date of E.piphany's invoice.
rules.explanation: Payment terms comply with the standard Net 30 requirement.

opposingFindings.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL E.PIPHANY'S LIABILITY HEREUNDER EXCEED THE SUM TOTAL OF PAYMENTS MADE BY HSNS UNDER THE INITIAL TERM OF THIS AGREEMENT.
opposingFindings.issue: The liability cap is strictly limited to payments made under the initial term without appropriate super-caps for IP or data breaches, failing to align with enterprise expectations.
opposingFindings.leverage: E.piphany will argue that tying the liability cap to total initial payments provides a balanced and predictable risk allocation given their pricing structure.

opposingFindings.quote: HSNS hereby agrees to indemnify, defend and hold harmless E.piphany, and its officers, directors and partners ... against any and all claims ... arising out of or resulting from (i) HSNS's providing or failure to provide Outsourcing Services
opposingFindings.issue: The indemnification obligation is heavily one-sided, requiring HSNS to indemnify E.piphany for broad outsourcing activities without a reciprocal indemnity from E.piphany for IP infringement or breach.
opposingFindings.leverage: E.piphany will argue that as the technology provider, they already offer a standard IP indemnification in Section 10.1 while HSNS must bear the operational risks of servicing Outsourcing Customers.

opposingFindings.quote: HSNS hereby assigns all right, title and interest in and to any customization, enhancement, amendment or changes made by or for HSNS pursuant to this Agreement
opposingFindings.issue: All modifications and enhancements created by or for HSNS are automatically assigned to E.piphany, depriving HSNS of ownership in custom developments paid for by them.
opposingFindings.leverage: E.piphany will assert that ownership uniformity of the core application and its modifications is essential to prevent fragmentation and protect their proprietary intellectual property.

opposingFindings.quote: E.piphany will invoice HSNS on a monthly basis for Professional Services rendered and for any applicable expense reimbursement. All Professional Services not otherwise specified in the Order Form shall be provided on a time and materials basis.
opposingFindings.issue: Professional services are billed on an open-ended time and materials basis without protective caps or milestones.
opposingFindings.leverage: E.piphany will maintain that time and materials billing is standard and necessary because the exact scope of professional services cannot always be predetermined.
